page: UpCloud CLOUDNATIVE-12xCPU-32GB is a virtual server instance categorized within the Cloud Native family, operating under the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 7542 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz, offering 12 shared vCPUs and 12 physical cores configured with 1 thread per core. The cache topology includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache per core cluster. Instruction set support includes standard AVX, AES, and SHA-NI cryptographic acceleration, while lacking AVX-512 extensions and AMX units.

System memory consists of 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation ratio of 2.67 GB per core. There is no bundled local storage provided with this instance type, requiring network-attached storage or external volume configuration for persistent file systems. Similarly, the instance excludes discrete GPU accelerators and complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate competitive general compute throughput across multi-core tests, registering a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,817.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 22,297.86. Single-threaded performance exhibits variance, reaching a strong Geekbench single-core score of 2,199.0 while scoring in the lowest tier on synthetic stress-ng single-core tests (787.29). Memory benchmarks yield 54.21 GB/sec read and 42.64 GB/sec write on large 256 MB blocks, although PassMark memory testing registers a weak 1,834.1. Medium 7B LLM inference text generation is limited at 4.94 tokens per second.

The 1:2.67 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as an economical compute-oriented platform where multi-threaded execution matters more than heavy RAM per thread or local disk I/O. CLOUDNATIVE-12xCPU-32GB fits parallel compilation jobs, containerized microservices, horizontal web application serving, compression workloads, and stateless background processing.
description: UpCloud CLOUDNATIVE-12xCPU-32GB is a compute-focused instance within UpCloud's Cloud Native series, powered by a 12-core AMD EPYC 7542 processor running at 2.0 GHz on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 32.0 GB of memory (2.67 GB per vCPU) and operates with shared CPU allocation. The configuration excludes onboard local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, requiring external volumes for persistent data. Multi-core performance is balanced, highlighted by a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,817.0, a PassMark CPU score of 22,297.86, and static web serving throughput of 9.33 GB/sec. Synthetic memory benchmarks show moderate bandwidth (54.21 GB/sec large block reads), though single-core stress-ng efficiency is limited. CLOUDNATIVE-12xCPU-32GB is well aligned for CI/CD compilation pipelines, container clusters, multi-threaded batch jobs, and scalable web serving.
